quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger out, as shown in the image?

options.text: The group will exit at the next off-ramp.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger out, all riders should move into a single-file line.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side the arrow points to.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An obstacle like a traffic island or barrier is ahead. You must stay on the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider holds their left arm out with their palm up and swings their arm upward, it means all riders should go faster.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue straight or exit from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and drive through.
Must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means that lane will leave the freeway. You have two choices: change lanes to stay on the freeway or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection is coming up. Watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to stay on the right side to avoid a hazard.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamond-shaped signs with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong direction.
You can go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a T intersection ahead and tells you to be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign means traffic is entering your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for vehicles turning left from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs show laws that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn drivers of work zones ahead. This sign tells you that the road is being repaired. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: This sign means that:

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must give the right-of-way to all pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Always look for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a traffic light is ahead. Get ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not working. When a rider's left arm is extended straight out, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. Complete your turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a side road is ahead. Be aware that traffic may enter from that side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter this road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safe speed limit for a residential area.
The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
The safe speed limit for an expressway entrance.
The safe speed limit for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed limit for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is broken.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that cyclists may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. When it rains, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the car ahead.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in groups, hand signals are used to communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm down with their palm back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you cannot enter from your current direction because traffic only flows one way.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm out with their palm down and swings it down, all riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead can fit only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you of upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This is a triangular "Yield" sign. When you see it, slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: These chevron signs show sharp road curves in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. Multiple signs mark the entire curve.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped warning signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Vertical traffic signals have red on top and green on the bottom. Horizontal signals have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid slowing traffic.
Change lanes, if safe, to make room for merging traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes, if safe, to make room for merging traffic.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic merge in.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
This lane is for buses and carpool vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if you see other cars.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection slowly. You do not always have to stop.
Stop only if traffic is coming on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Traffic must merge to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end soon. You need to move left and join the other traffic.

questions.question: What type of condition does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look for trains before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to slow down and let other traffic pass. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a curve is coming.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing through the intersection. Wait for the intersection to be clear before you go.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first. You must give the right-of-way to traffic already in the intersection or on the road you are entering.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards and conditions. This sign warns you that the road curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to crossing traffic.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest legal speed for that road under good conditions. You may need to drive slower if conditions are not ideal, such as bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right side of the center divider or median.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you there is an intersection ahead. A road is joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells you that you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are driving over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road is about to cross a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign has a red circle with a red line through it. It means the action shown is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a person with a flag is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that you are approaching a steep downhill grade.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells you that passing other vehicles is not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The road dips sharply at the railroad tracks, and the bottom of low vehicles may hit or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is roadwork ahead; detour to the right.
Slow down. The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves sharply. Slow down as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic must flow on this street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When your left arm is extended straight out to the left, it signals that you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep downhill road ahead. Reduce your speed to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does this signal mean?

options.text: You are about to slow down.

questions.explanation: When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals that you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep hill is coming. Be ready to slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A stop sign is coming. Get ready to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: A steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: The road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
